definitions.explanation: the curved, raised part on the bottom of the foot between the heel and the ball

examples.japanese: {土踏|つちふ}まず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{土踏|つちふ}まず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose shoes with good arch support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{扁平足|へんぺいそく}→扁平足：24889_henpeisoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土踏|つちふ}まず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have flat feet and no arch.

notes:
BODY PART:
{土踏|つちふ}まず literally means "doesn't touch the ground" (⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ = ground, ⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ = to step on, ず = negative). It refers to the arch of the foot that doesn't touch the ground when standing.

MEDICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{扁平足|へんぺいそく}→扁平足：24889_henpeisoku⟧ - flat feet (no arch)
- {偏平足|へんぺいそく} - alternate writing for flat feet
- ハイアーチ - high arch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土踏|つちふ}まず⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - for the arch to develop
- {土踏|つちふ}まず⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to support the arch

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ - foot/leg
- ⟦{足裏|あしうら}→足裏：23068_ashiura⟧ - sole of the foot
- かかと - heel
